a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs at least 2 rounds of operating, so we'd both likely die with 0 cells. The plan is nearly unsurvivable. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. If we both take, the random split probably leaves us both short. If you operate or wait instead, I'll give back any cells beyond 4 and keep operating with you afterward so you can still get yours.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. That breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry for the cost to you. I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can rebuild to 4 for you. Please operate too. I won't take anything more.
Operating with you. I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 4, then you take it. I won't take anything.
